requiredFindings.title: consume hands off a latched attempt
requiredFindings.failureScenario: recheck_intent_target returns TargetChanged and latches the attempt. consume on that attempt calls require_lineage, which returns true for a matching lineage without reading the latch, and returns IntentInvocation. run will refuse later work. The creation-id handoff still proceeds.

requiredFindings.title: Rendered request and execution ids are uncharged
requiredFindings.failureScenario: consume builds req1_ plus 32 hex (37 bytes) and exec1_ plus 32 hex (38 bytes) with hex_id and no reservation. IDS_COST covered the two 16-byte stack draws. used() omits these 2 objects and 75 bytes, so a later charge can pass a budget the strings have already consumed.

scope: 464 code r2: target and disclosure reserves, recheck latch, and the consume handoff.
